title: Cohomology of a filtered CE step computes the fixed stupid truncation
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $K$ a bounded-below cochain complex of abelian étale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and $T$ a termwise hypercohomology presentation [def-weil-pbc-termwise-hypercohomology-presentation]. For integers $p,q$, write $\sigma_{\ge q}K$ for the complex equal to $K$ in degrees at least $q$ and zero below $q$, with canonical inclusion $\iota:\sigma_{\ge q}K\to K$. There is an isomorphism $e:H^p((T.L).\mathrm{step}(q))\cong H^p(X,\sigma_{\ge q}K)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] such that $H^p(j_q)\circ(T.c(p))=e\circ H^p(R\Gamma(\iota))$, in diagrammatic composition order, where $j_q$ is the filtered-step inclusion into the mapped total. No element-membership predicate or image-filtration equality is asserted.

lean.statement: theorem etale_filtered_step_cohomology (X : Scheme.{u}) (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) (T : EtaleTermwiseHypercohomology X K) (p q : ℤ) : ∃ e : ((T.L.step q : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ℤ).homology p) ≅ (cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X p).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (K.obj.stupidTrunc (ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntGE q))), HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (T.L.step q).arrow p ≫ (T.c p).hom = e.hom ≫ (cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X p).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map (K.obj.ιStupidTrunc (ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntGE q)))
